text:
sam_support: Customer acme-inc can't start free trial — card-on-file flow fails during 3DS. Flow returns CARDINAL_CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT and we never get the issuer webhook. Customer email: sam@acme.com. Payment intent: pi_3K9a8b7c6d5e4f3g2. Seen in eu-west1. Help?

li_payments: Do we have the raw payment_intent log for that id? paste the id + earliest server timestamp so I can look it up in Splunk.

sam_support: pi_3K9a8b7c6d5e4f3g2 — earliest server log 2026-03-16T18:02:13Z. Provider: Cardinal via our tokenization proxy. Provider error: CARDINAL_CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT. Snippet of our request to tokenization service:

```
POST /v1/tokenize HTTP/1.1
Host: tokenproxy.redwood.internal
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "payment_intent": "pi_3K9a8b7c6d5e4f3g2",
  "card": {"number": "************4242", "exp": "12/28"},
  "three_ds": {"return_url": "https://checkout.acme/callback", "challenge_window": 30}
}
```

eng_oncall: Is the client getting a 504 or an interactive failure? Any stack traces from the tokenization proxy?

sam_support: UI shows a spinner then error: 'Payment verification timed out'. Our API returns 504 after 30s from the tokenization proxy. Log line: `POST /v1/tokenize -> timeout after 30000ms` then we mark payment as failed and block trial grant.

marcus_payments: We've seen a small spike of Cardinal timeouts in eu-west1 last night. Common cause: issuer redirect losing session query params (MD/PaRes) or Cardinal policy returning a timeout if the challenge takes >30s. Can you confirm the redirect domain is correct and that the `MD` param is present in the callback? If issuer drops it we can't correlate the webhook.

sam_support: I repro'd on sandbox by forcing a delay >30s (simulator param `challenge_delay=31s`). Repro steps for eng: 1) create payment_intent, 2) start 3DS flow with challenge_delay=31s, 3) wait — we see tokenization proxy timeout, no webhook. Curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://tokenproxy.redwood.internal/v1/tokenize \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"payment_intent":"pi_test","card":{"number":"4242424242424242"},"three_ds":{"simulate_challenge_delay":31}}'
```

ryan_se: Short-term: support can manually grant the trial credits to the user while payments root-causes it. Longer-term: product could accept a 'pending-3ds' state if webhook doesn't arrive in X seconds and prompt user to retry instead of blocking the trial entirely. That's a product decision but worth logging.

li_payments: I'll open an incident with Cardinal and include the logs + region. Also will add a metric for `cardinal.challenge_timeout` with region tag so we can alert on spikes. @ops_jen can we safely increase the tokenization proxy timeout in eu-west1 to 40s as a mitigation canary?

ops_jen: We can bump proxy timeout to 40s in a canary pool, but that will hold threads longer and may affect throughput — do it for eu-west1 small subset first. I'll schedule the canary now.

billing-bot: Ticket created: PAY-7891 — subject: "Cardinal challenge_timeout blocking trial grants in eu-west1". Assignee: li_payments. Labels: payments, support-escalation, trial-credits. ETA: 48h.

sam_support: :thumbsup: I issued a one-time trial credit for acme-inc and updated PAY-7891 with the customer note. I'll monitor the ticket and paste any provider incident updates here.

marcus_payments: Also adding a quick validate script to check `return_url` has MD/PaRes when Cardinal calls back. If issuer behavior is inconsistent we may need to fallback to session-based matching.

ryan_se: Thanks — also log the number of manual grants this week so we can quantify customer impact for product decision.

sam_support: Will do. Closing the immediate loop with the customer, keeping the thread for incident updates.
